top_signals.title: Bond Traders on Edge as Middle East Conflict Clouds Fed Outlook
top_signals.summary: Bond traders head into the week pricing in roughly a one-in-three chance of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike on Wednesday, after flaring Middle East tensions fueled volatility in oil prices and Treasury yields, heightening inflation worries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kioxia faces more volatility as leveraged ETFs hit Japan stocks
top_signals.summary: The Japanese memory chipmaker is in the crosshairs of a rush by investors to ramp up bets on the AI boom that has turned leveraged ETFs into a $270 billion business.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
